cockpit.title: Run and configure 1C integrations from one work center.
cockpit.description: 1C endpoints, OData enrichment, XML routes, generated 1C HTTP examples and Timeline diagnostics in one place.
cockpit.commonRoutesDesc: Start from a business scenario, then refine matchers, OData lookups and target payloads in the wizard.
cockpit.academyDesc: Guided path for inbound token, named OData connection, lookup, JSON payload and final endpoint response.
cockpit.startLearningDesc: Concepts, endpoint contract, OData profiles and visual flow steps in order.
cockpit.createODataProfilesDesc: OData ERP, OData USP or WMS with URL, user, password/secret and metadata test.
cockpit.useRecipeDesc: Copy the full business recipe with request examples, Timeline checks and common mistakes.
cockpit.noConnectorsDetail: Create a 1C, REST or printer connector to see channel health.
cockpit.integrationsDesc: Only 1C-related routes are shown: sourced from 1C, targeting 1C, or created from 1C presets.
cockpit.noIntegrationsDetail: Create the first route from 1C to API, OData enrichment, XML bridge or printer flow.
cockpit.noEventsDetail: New XML/OData/print events will appear here with a Timeline link.

odataConnections.title: OData connection catalog
odataConnections.description: Create named profiles such as OData ERP, OData USP and OData WMS. Pipeline steps then select a business connection instead of generic connector JSON.
odataConnections.newConnectionHint: Choose the 1C base where OMH will search data.
odataConnections.name: Name
odataConnections.emptyDetail: Create OData ERP or OData USP first, then use it in OData Master and Visual Flow Builder.

odataExplorer.title: Query 1C OData safely
odataExplorer.description: Choose the 1C base, build resource and filter, run the query, inspect JSON and save a lookup template for a pipeline.
odataExplorer.trainingDesc: Use mock ERP/WMS to learn filters, `$select` and JSON extraction before connecting real 1C.
odataExplorer.connectionHint: Choose the 1C base where OMH will search data.
odataExplorer.createProfileFirstDetail: Open OData Connections, add OData ERP/USP/WMS, then return here.
odataExplorer.safeWorkflowDesc: Build `$filter` here first, run it, inspect JSON, then copy the same resource/filter/select into Flow Builder. `$select` should contain only fields you need later.
odataExplorer.fieldHint: Exact OData field name from 1C metadata.
odataExplorer.valueHint: Use a real value here. In Flow Builder this becomes {{request.body.inn}} or another placeholder.
odataExplorer.filterTitle: Raw OData filter. You can edit it manually after using Filter builder.
odataExplorer.selectTitle: Comma-separated fields returned by OData. Use this to pick only what pipeline needs.
odataExplorer.paginationTitle: By default, Explorer sends one OData request.
odataExplorer.paginationHint: Keep this off when testing a filter like you would in a browser or Postman: OMH sends only the first page without $skip. Enable it to read several pages: the first page has no $skip, then following pages use $skip=$top, 2*$top and so on. In 1C, $skip can trigger AUTOORDER and change filter behavior.
odataExplorer.filterTemplateHint: Template version of the filter. Example: ИНН eq '{inn}'.
odataExplorer.extractJsonHint: Map output names to OData fields. Example: {"contractor_uuid":"Ref_Key"}.
odataExplorer.extractInvalid: Extract JSON is invalid. Use an object like {"field":"ODataField"}.
odataExplorer.queryResultHint: Run an OData query to inspect request and response.

flowBuilder.title: Manage created integrations
flowBuilder.description: Review, test, duplicate and promote integrations that were already assembled by a wizard or advanced builder.
flowBuilder.noFlowsDetail: Start with “Create integration” or install a ready marking scenario.

enterprisePolish.queueSubtitle: Prioritized operational queue with retry, worker and timeline visibility.
enterprisePolish.dlqSubtitle: Recover failed transactions without losing artifacts or timeline evidence.
enterprisePolish.monitorSubtitle: Live queue posture across waiting, processing, retry, DLQ and completed work.
enterprisePolish.objectsSubtitle: Shared object vocabulary for mappings, rules and resolver targets.
enterprisePolish.resolversSubtitle: Resolve customers, products, warehouses, orders and printers through cache/OData/REST.
enterprisePolish.transformsSubtitle: Reusable transforms for mappings and operational data shaping.
enterprisePolish.rulesSubtitle: Configurable IF/SWITCH/SET/STOP/FAIL rules for runtime decisions.
enterprisePolish.businessObjectsDesc: Stable vocabulary for integrations: Customer, Product, Warehouse, orders, shipments, stock and printing jobs.
enterprisePolish.resolversPageDesc: Reusable business lookups that hide OData/REST details behind stable names like resolve_customer and resolve_product.
enterprisePolish.safeTransformsDesc: Normalize fields without custom code: trim, replace, uppercase, date formatting, hashing, defaults and JSON helpers.
enterprisePolish.ruleSetsDesc: Safe configurable IF/THEN logic for routing, variables, payload updates, stop/fail/retry decisions.
enterprisePolish.environmentTitle: Separate dev, test and production safely.
enterprisePolish.environmentDesc: Profiles hold target-specific variables and secret references. Change sets resolve these values only when applying into the current environment.
enterprisePolish.changeSetsTitle: Package drafts into audited release change sets.
enterprisePolish.changeSetsDesc: Create from tested drafts, export a reference-only package, preview imports, map secrets/environment variables and apply without silent overwrite.

training.title: Executable sandbox for 1C, OData, DNP and printing
training.subtitle: Install mock ERP/WMS, DNP API, printer, demo flows and test cases. Lessons run like real integrations and produce timelines.
training.examplesHint: Open each example in Test Console or run it directly. Error examples fail by design to teach diagnostics.
training.runHint: Run an example to see the result and Timeline link.

workbench.heroTitle: Receive a request, run OData, return the answer.
workbench.heroDescription: One page for a real scenario: paste an inbound request, choose OData actions, build a JSON/XML/raw response, test it and save the integration.
workbench.multipartSample: Choose a file below. Body is not used for multipart.
workbench.fileEndpointRequired: Choose an endpoint before sending a file.
workbench.fileRequired: Choose a file for the multipart endpoint.
workbench.saveBeforeTest: Save the integration before sending a test request.
workbench.previewFailed: Could not build the integration preview. Check inbound JSON, headers and response body.
workbench.saveFailed: Could not save the integration. Check required fields and OData steps.
workbench.createdDescription: Created from Request/Response Workbench: receive request, run OData lookups and return a synchronous response.
workbench.guidanceTitle: Test an existing endpoint or build the integration step by step
workbench.guidanceDescription: If the endpoint is already published, use quick test: choose the endpoint, paste the request body and open Timeline. If the integration does not exist yet, use build mode: the workbench guides you from sample payload to OData steps, response and saved flow.
workbench.quickDescription: Use it for smoke tests, token/header/body checks and response diagnostics.
workbench.buildDescription: Use it for a new synchronous integration with OData lookup and JSON/XML/raw response.
workbench.afterRunDescription: After sending a request, verify steps, external responses and readable diagnostics.
workbench.quickFormDescription: Quick mode: choose an endpoint, paste JSON/XML/raw body or attach a file, then inspect the Timeline response.
workbench.fileHint: The file will be sent as multipart/form-data field `file`.
workbench.step01Description: Describe the external service and the endpoint it will call.
workbench.step02Title: What arrives in the inbound request
workbench.step02Description: Paste a JSON, XML or raw text example. Fields that can be used in OData filters and response templates appear below.
workbench.step03Description: This workbench fully supports one or multiple OData queries. Other actions stay available through future advanced builder extensions.
workbench.step04Title: What to return to the external service
workbench.step04Description: Choose sync/proxy/accepted mode and build the response body. JSON, XML and raw text are supported here.
workbench.responseModeAccepted: Accept to queue and return event_id
workbench.step05Description: First preview without a real request, then create the integration flow and send a test request from this page.
workbench.emptyPreviewDetail: Click “Preview without saving” to inspect variables, OData queries and the final response.
workbench.extractedHint: Use these paths in OData filters, resources or response templates.
workbench.requiredOData: Required step: stop the integration if OData returns nothing
workbench.xmlVariablesHint: These variables are created by the `xml_extract` step before OData. If you do not select fields manually, Workbench uses the first detected XML fields.
workbench.jsonInvalidDetail: JSON cannot be parsed. Check quotes, commas and closing braces.
workbench.jsonObjectRequiredDetail: expected a JSON object like {"key":"value"}, not an array or string.
workbench.responseInvalidJsonPreview: Response JSON is not valid yet. Check quotes, commas and template variables.

sharedBuilder.flowDryRunDesc: Inspect the generated integration before saving it.
sharedBuilder.payloadTemplateHelp: Use only the fields you need from request and OData lookups. A full placeholder like {{request.body.lines}} preserves arrays/objects.
sharedBuilder.commonODataHelp: After an OData lookup saved as contractor, use {{contractor.Ref_Key}}, {{contractor.Description}} or {{steps.get_contractor.first.Ref_Key}}. If top returns a list, use {{steps.get_prices.items}} or {{prices[0].Price}}.
sharedBuilder.jsonTemplateTitle: This JSON is rendered after OData steps. Put only fields the target API or second OData query needs.
